step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to obtain the required information.
Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding, or if the client responded to the N-10-00-00 ACS letter:

ul.li: If the client was reached , go to step 8.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Reason for separation .
Comments: Type “Voluntary leaving — [employer’s name] — [last day worked] — client.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the client was reminded during fact-finding to submit the missing document that provides the authorization to quit employment:
In NWS, move the WI related to the missing document that provides the authorization to quit employment to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Fact finding client .
Bring forward date: Enter the date of the most recent contact + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the document that provides the authorization to quit employment is on file:

ul.li: If no, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2

step.cmd: Determine if the information on file shows that a designated authority authorized the client to quit the employment to participate in an employment activity:

ul.li: If no, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 Reassigning the issue to Level 2
